verdict.rationale: The evidence documents OpenAPI specifications, which users could turn into Postman collections, plus llms.txt and markdown renderings of the docs. None of these is an interactive API reference with runnable examples: generating Postman collections is a user-side workaround or building block, and the docs surfaces are static. The axis applies to a payments API provider, so the absence of evidence yields none.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
